intro: Kabira Skincare Vitamin C Body Oil is a luxurious blend designed to deeply nourish, brighten, and rejuvenate your skin. Infused with Vitamin C, this lightweight body oil helps improve skin tone, fade dark spots, and restore a radiant glow. Its non-greasy formula absorbs quickly, leaving your skin soft, smooth, and luminous. Suitable for all skin types, this body oil provides lasting hydration while protecting against environmental stressors and premature aging.
Perfect for daily use, it enhances skin elasticity, reduces dullness, and gives your skin a healthy, youthful appearance with every application.

p: Brightens & Evens Skin Tone – Vitamin C helps reduce dark spots and enhances natural radiance.
Deep Hydration – Locks in moisture, keeping skin supple and smooth throughout the day.
Antioxidant Protection – Shields skin from environmental damage and free radicals.
Improves Skin Texture – Regular use promotes soft, glowing, and healthy-looking skin.
Lightweight & Non-Greasy – Absorbs quickly without leaving an oily residue.
Suitable for All Skin Types – Gentle formula ideal for daily use on all skin tones and types.

Aqua, HEC (Hydroxy ethyl cellulose) Glycerine, Hyaluronic acid, EDTA, disodium, Niacinamide, Ethyl Ascorbic, Acid, Glycolic acid, Glutathione, Licorice Extract, Ri ce water, Aloevera Extract, Tea Tree Extract,Sodium PCA, Phenoxy Ethanol, Propylene Glycol Salicylic acid, D-Panthenol (Pro vit.B5), Perfume

Apply on clean, dry skin after a shower or bath. Take a few drops of the oil in your palm. Gently massage onto the body using circular motions until fully absorbed. Use daily, preferably morning and night, for best results. Can be used alone or under a moisturizer for extra hydration.
